scenario: Identity slot designation via `by:` per LSER.10.13. `by:` is a block-option that defaults to `entity_id` (LFAC.1.2.2 convention) when the schema has it. Pin: a series on a Sensor schema with an `entity_id` slot and no explicit `by:` compiles, so the default resolves. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES. `compile_ok` reads neither the identity it resolves to nor the absorber's pattern.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    count sliding 10_s

rule trig:
    Sensor t where count(t.state) > 0
->
    log info "x"
